role: Mechanistic synthetic diagnosis of why the frozen real-climate qualification failed. It cannot reclassify that failure, cannot alter its thresholds/gates, and cannot open observed flower-colour inference.
questions: Q1: Is the fixed 32-axis representation too coarse relative to the true shared response axis on actual climate support?
Q2: Even on the true response axis, do sampled species/photos actually span their transition thresholds often enough to identify a colour change?
Q3: Does regional holdout create projection leverage or colour-state loss between training and evaluation samples?
Q4: How much raw held-out sharing score is recovered by a privileged one-axis augmentation that adds the simulator's true common axis to the frozen 32-axis grid?

fixed_diagnostics.axis_vector_coverage: maximum absolute cosine between the true shared R4 axis and the frozen 32 candidate axes
fixed_diagnostics.support_projected_axis_coverage: maximum absolute Pearson correlation between true-axis and each frozen-axis projections on the exact selected photos, computed by fold
fixed_diagnostics.transition_exposure: fraction of selected species whose 20 photo projections straddle that species' simulator threshold, separately for training and evaluation roles
fixed_diagnostics.synthetic_colour_variability: fraction of selected species containing both artificial colour states among the 20 scheduled photos, separately for training and evaluation roles
fixed_diagnostics.true_projection_sd: mean within-species SD of the true-axis projection among the 20 scheduled photos, separately for training and evaluation roles
fixed_diagnostics.privileged_axis_augmentation: recompute the exact intercept-marginal model after adding the simulator true common axis as a 33rd candidate axis; report raw score change only
fixed_diagnostics.parent_score_reconstruction: recompute the original frozen 32-axis raw score and require exact numerical agreement with the parent full-artifact score before accepting any diagnostic row

required_outputs: one row per block-scenario-replicate with all fixed diagnostics
block/scenario summaries with medians and 10th/90th percentiles
association of frozen parent score with axis coverage, transition exposure and colour variability
all source/code/output checksums and colour-firewall guards

interpretation_ceiling.axis_augmentation_large: suggests representation/axis approximation contributes to the failed synthetic qualification; does not validate an empirical axis search
interpretation_ceiling.transition_exposure_low: suggests the actual sampled climate support does not repeatedly cross species response thresholds at the chosen effect scale
interpretation_ceiling.both_poor: both response-axis approximation and environmental leverage can contribute
interpretation_ceiling.neither_poor: remaining failure is more consistent with finite-sample response/sharing estimation or geographic transfer rather than these two diagnostics

stop_rules: Any mismatch with parent synthetic labels, schedules, scores or checksums stops the diagnostic.
No parent threshold/gate, nuisance family, seed, species/photo frame or block may be changed.
No observed flower-colour value may be read.
The next empirical stage remains closed regardless of diagnostic direction.
claim_ceiling: Post-failure synthetic identifiability diagnosis only. It explains limitations of the failed qualification; it does not rescue it and is not evidence for real heat, water-balance, dryness, radiation or flower-colour responses.
